note: All three facts are proved: monotoneOn_f₂ is the monotonicity of t log(x/t) on (0, x/e]. The second inequality is stated with 1/(4q) for 1/q (the same inequality scaled) via F₂_mono on (0, x], a larger range.

/-- `t log(x/t)` is increasing on `(0, x/e]`. -/
theorem monotoneOn_f₂ (hx : 0 < x) :
    MonotoneOn (fun t => t * (Real.log x - Real.log t)) (Set.Ioc 0 (x / rexp 1)) := by
  refine monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Ioc 0 (x / rexp 1)) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact fun t ht => (hasDerivAt_f₂ x ht.1).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  · intro t ht
    rw [interior_Ioc] at ht
    exact (hasDerivAt_f₂ x ht.1).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  · intro t ht
    rw [interior_Ioc] at ht
    rw [(hasDerivAt_f₂ x ht.1).deriv]
    have h1 : Real.log t ≤ Real.log x - 1 := by
      have := Real.log_le_log ht.1 ht.2.le
      rw [Real.log_div hx.ne' (Real.exp_pos 1).ne', Real.log_exp] at this; exact this
    linarith

proof_context.conclusion: `t ↦ t(log x − log t)` (i.e. $t\log(x/t)$) is monotone on `(0, x/e]`, the fact the text cites.

theorem F₂_mono {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hst : s ≤ t) (htx : t ≤ x) :
    s ^ 2 / 2 * (1 / 2 + Real.log x - Real.log s) ≤ t ^ 2 / 2 * (1 / 2 + Real.log x - Real.log t) := by

proof_context.conclusion: `s²/2·(1/2+log x - log s) ≤ t²/2·(1/2+log x - log t)` for `0<s≤t≤x`.

have h1 : M / x * (Real.log x - Real.log M) ≤ 1 / rexp 1 := by
      have := mul_log_le_inv_e (show 0 < M / x by positivity)
      rw [Real.log_div hM.ne' hx.ne'] at this; linarith
    have h2 : M ^ 2 / (4 * q) * (1 / 2 + Real.log x - Real.log M) ≤
        D ^ 2 / (4 * q) * (1 / 2 + Real.log x - Real.log D) := by
      have := F₂_mono hM hMD hDx
      have e : ∀ t : ℝ, t ^ 2 / (4 * q) * (1 / 2 + Real.log x - Real.log t) =
          (t ^ 2 / 2 * (1 / 2 + Real.log x - Real.log t)) / (2 * q) := fun t => by field_simp; ring
      rw [e, e]; gcongr

proof_context.conclusion: `(M/x)(log x - log M) ≤ 1/e` (from `mul_log_le_inv_e`) and `M²/(4q)(1/2+log x-log M) ≤ D²/(4q)(1/2+log x - log D)` for `M ≤ D ≤ x`.

theorem mul_log_le_inv_e {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) : u * (-Real.log u) ≤ 1 / rexp 1 := by
  have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show 0 < 1 / (rexp 1 * u) by positivity)
  rw [Real.log_div (by norm_num) (by positivity), Real.log_one, Real.log_mul (by positivity)
    hu.ne', Real.log_exp] at h
  have : u * (1 / (rexp 1 * u)) = 1 / rexp 1 := by field_simp
  nlinarith
